text:
Breathe in, Tim. Feel your feet on the ground.
You are building work you love, one step at a time.
You know what to do next, and you do it.
Your body is strong. Your mind is clear.
Every step today moves you forward.
You have done hard things before. You can do this.
Keep going. And so it is.
style: Speak like a steady, quietly confident coach walking beside one person: grounded, warm, low and even in pitch, at a natural conversational pace. No salesy lift, no announcer voice, no smile in the voice, and do not stress single words. Let each line settle, with a short pause after it.
